detailZones.title: Easels and windows
detailZones.description: Inspect the visible easels, blank canvases, window frames, blinds and radiator hardware.

detailZones.title: Student art worktable
detailZones.description: Trace the visible student table, stools, paint bottles, palettes, brushes, paper and trays.

detailZones.title: Clay and sculpture table
detailZones.description: Inspect the visible clay slab, sculpting tools, rolling pin, trays, work mat and table structure.

detailZones.title: Drying, storage and display
detailZones.description: Trace the visible drying rack, blank papers, storage shelves, bins, aprons and display hardware.

detailZones.title: Teacher preparation and sink
detailZones.description: Inspect the visible demonstration table, tablet, cutting mat, drawers, sink, faucet and cabinet hardware.

detailZones.title: Studio floor and room finish
detailZones.description: Trace the visible washable floor, drain, base trim, ceiling lights, doorway, plant and room panels.

anchorAudit.rationale: The final 1600 by 900 school-art-studio photograph was inspected at source and output resolution. It retains 151 independently pointable easel, worktable, paint, clay, drying, storage, sink, doorway and room-finish parts. People, identities, lesson content, artwork authorship, school branding, chemical claims and hidden building systems were excluded.
